title: First Water Crisis
summary: Haven Deep's reclaimers were built for a sealed vault, not a growing surface population. As people spread out, clean water becomes the first hard limit on survival. The crisis can be solved by engineering, by finding a clean source, by rationing — or not at all.

beats.title: The filters fail
beats.description: Aging reclaimer filters clog or crack while demand grows.

beats.title: Something in the water
beats.description: Thirst drives people to unsafe sources; sickness follows.

beats.title: Who controls the water
beats.description: A council forms to ration water, or scouts chase rumours of a clean aquifer.

possibleOutcomes: Water purification is rediscovered and the crisis fades into memory.
A rationing council becomes the first real government on the surface.
The Old Reservoir is found and becomes the region's lifeline.
Repeated shortages hollow out the bunker and its people scatter or die.
